responsibility: Primary target configuration header for the ARC backend. It defines target macros, default CPU selection, driver specs, symbol flags for call/cmem attributes, feature-test macros derived from selected CPU/FPU/options, ABI and code-generation policies, instruction-length and delay-slot helpers, and numerous backend configuration constants that parameterize both arc.cc and the ARC machine descriptions.
same_name_distinction: This is the ARC backend’s configuration header, providing macros, declarations, and target-policy definitions used by the rest of the port; unlike arc.cc it does not implement the hooks, unlike arc.md it does not define instruction patterns, and unlike arc.opt it does not describe user-visible options.
